from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyOperatingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Represents the operating cash flow data for a single company in the 2025 Q1 period."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the company, e.g. 000011")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period covering the quarter")
    metric_name: str = Field(description="The financial metric label as written in the document")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from operating activities amount")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., Yuan")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    operating_cash_flows: list[CompanyOperatingCashFlow]
